sql_query: SELECT DISTINCT project FROM SupplyChain_Warehouse.meta.sp_registry WHERE is_active = 1 AND project IS NOT NULL

SELECT r.target_schema, r.target_table FROM SupplyChain_Warehouse.meta.sp_registry r WHERE r.layer IN ('BRZ','REF') AND r.is_active = 1 AND (r.cron_expression IS NULL OR r.next_run_time IS NULL OR r.next_run_time <= GETUTCDATE()) AND r.project = '@{pipeline().parameters.project_name}'
SELECT DISTINCT wave FROM SupplyChain_Warehouse.meta.slv_dag_waves_runtime ORDER BY wave

@concat('SELECT r.target_schema, r.target_table FROM SupplyChain_Warehouse.meta.slv_dag_waves_runtime w INNER JOIN SupplyChain_Warehouse.meta.sp_registry r ON w.sp_name = r.sp_name WHERE w.wave = ', string(pipeline().parameters.wave_number))
